Answer five (5) of items (a) - (h). Each item carries four (4) marks. ​ ​ ​ ​ (a) How old was Abraham when he died? What promise did he get from God before his death? (b) What is meant by the “Patriarchs?” (c) Come near, that I may feel you, my son, to know whether you are my son… or not.” (Gen.27:21). (d) Who lived in the Promised Land before the Israelites took it? (Josh.3:10). Mention four (4) of them. (e) “You shall not pass through” (Numb.20:18). (i) Name the speaker. (ii) To whom were the words spoken? (iii) Name the place where these words were spoken. (iv) State the occasion. (f) Give a list of people who were buried at Mechpelah, excluding Abraham, Sara and Joseph. (g) “We shall surely die for we have seen God.” (Judg.13:22). (i) Who said these words? (ii) To whom were they spoken? (iii) What was the occasion? (iv) What was the outcome? (h) “See, he has brought among us a Hebrew to insult us; he came in to me to lie with me, and I cried out with a loud voice…” (Gen.39:14). (i) Name the speaker. (ii) Identify the addressee. (iii) In which occasion were the words spoken? (iv) What was the outcome? Match the items in List A with the responses in List B by writing the letter of the corresponding ​ ​ response beside the item number in List A. ​ ​ List A List B (i) Moses A One of the minor judges (ii) Joshua B Another name of Abram (iii) Jacob C Son of King Saul (iv) Laban D Father of David (v) Joseph E Captain of Pharaoh’s guard (vi) Benoni F Mother of Dan and Naphtali (vii) Miriam and Aaron G Disobeyed God by taking forbidden things from Jericho (viii) Abimelech H He said, “I will not let you go, unless you bless me.” (ix) Jair I This name means “Son of my sorrow” (x) Jonathan J He was 120 years when he died K He was not a Jew L He was 200 years when he died M Spoke against Moses for marrying a Cushite woman N He sent two spies to investigate Jericho O He ruled over Israel for three years P The only son of Jacob and Leah Q Father of Leah and Rachel R To this man God made the Rainbow a Sign of Covenant with Him S One of the major judges T The name means “He adds” Page 3 of 4 Find this and other free resources at: https://maktaba.tetea.org ​ Find this and other free resources at: http://maktaba.tetea.org ​

“Yet I have born him a son in his old age (Gen. 21:7). (a) Who are “I” and “him” referring to? (b) Who was the “son”? What is the meaning of the name? (c) Who else bore him a son? What was his name? (d) Give reason(s) why the woman in (c) above bore a son with him.

Answer the following questions according to the book of Exodus: (a) Why did Moses fly to Median? (b) While in Median whose daughter did Moses marry? (c) How did God reveal Himself to Moses? (d) State God’s commission to him.

“Why have you brought the assembly of the LORD into this wilderness, that we should die here, both we and our cattle” (Numbers 20:4). (a) Who said these words and to whom? (b) From where and to where were they going? (c) What did the addressee(s) do about their complaint?

“Go from your country and your kindred and your father’s house to the land that I will show you.” (Gen. 12:1). (a) Who spoke these words? (b) To whom was he speaking? (c) What was promised to the addressed person?
“But Sisera fled away on foot to the tent of Jael the wife of Heber, the Kenite …” (Judges 4:17). (a) Who was Sisera? (b) Explain what happened when he met Jael the wife of Heber?
